product_one_liner.value: iVoyant’s Koodisi connects business systems through no-code workflow automation and built-in API management for enterprise and mid-market organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: The official product page describes no-code business-system integration and built-in API management, while Koodisi’s overview identifies enterprise and mid-market users. Its footer identifies Ivoyant LLC as the product owner. Sources: https://www.ivoyant.com/products/koodisi; https://koodisi.com/what-is-koodisi; https://koodisi.com/pricing.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes an enterprise plan quoted according to deployment, scale, and support requirements; numeric prices are not required by the question: https://koodisi.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: iVoyant’s capability statement names both organizations in its past-performance examples, rather than as partners or investors: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement. | named_customers.0: Named in the official past-performance capability statement: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement. | named_customers.1: Named in the official past-performance capability statement: https://www.ivoyant.com/capability-statement.

employee_band.notes: The available company record reports 82 employees, consistent with LeadIQ’s approximately 81 employees as of September 2026, placing the company in 51–100. This conflicts with its broader LinkedIn company-size band, so confidence is reduced. Sources: https://tracxn.com; https://leadiq.com/c/ivoyant/5c54a9d921000027af661378/employee-directory.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official Ivoyant/Koodisi about page explicitly labels its Atlanta address as headquarters: https://koodisi.com/about. | hq_country: The headquarters address is listed in Atlanta, Georgia, United States: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/ivoyant.

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile states that it was founded in 2014: https://linkedin.com/company/ivoyant-llc.

eng_blog.notes: Under the requested strict product-build definition, the blog review established one clear in-house-product engineering article, describing LLM routing in PlatformNX’s Co-pilot. The other concrete build narratives concern a marketing-site migration and a personal-finance CRM experiment, rather than construction of iVoyant’s products; two qualifying engineer-authored product-build posts were not established. Sources: https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs; https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs/text-classification-with-llms-powering-intelligent-user-content-routing-in-enterprises; https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs/migrating-a-marketing-site-without-losing-what-works; https://www.ivoyant.com/blogs/building-a-personal-finances-crm-with-firebase-and-ai.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation hub links to a first-workflow tutorial, application-building documentation, activity references, API management, and AI/MCP documentation: https://docs.koodisi.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists an AI/ML Engineer, and the live application describes NLP, LLM development, and model deployment responsibilities. Sources: https://boards.greenhouse.io/ivoyant; https://boards.greenhouse.io/ivoyant/jobs/5257928004.

model_provider.notes: Koodisi’s documentation explicitly says its OpenAI activities use models available to the user’s OpenAI account and call the OpenAI REST API. This establishes a supported provider, not an exclusive underlying model: https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/list-of-available-activities/openai.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: iVoyant explicitly announces that it is SOC 2 Type II certified on its company LinkedIn page: https://linkedin.com/company/27041701. ISO 27001 is excluded because the product security page says its certificate remains in the issuing pipeline: https://koodisi.com/security. The product security page also retains pending SOC 2 language, creating a discrepancy with the company’s explicit certification announcement. | compliance_certs.0: The company explicitly announces SOC 2 Type II certification: https://linkedin.com/company/27041701. hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists AI/ML Engineer, Frontend Developer, Full Stack Lead Engineer, Test Engineer, and UX Designer, with no qualifying SDR, BDR, or account-executive role: https://boards.greenhouse.io/ivoyant.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 1.2.7 is explicitly dated October 2026 and marked released to beta and production. It introduces Agent Studio and AI-driven workflow building, deployment, and testing—major capabilities within the six-month window, not merely bug fixes: https://docs.koodisi.com/release-notes/v-1.2.7/.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small four-person leadership page was checked, and no recent executive arrival or departure was identified in the company updates reviewed. The COO’s profile places her joining in 2018. This is a negative finding under the requested team-page rule, but the official page does not supply complete tenure dates. Sources: https://www.ivoyant.com/company; https://theorg.com/org/ivoyant/org-chart/sonya-b; https://linkedin.com/company/27041701.
